There are 60 minutes in an hour.

Regarding the competitor analysis: Streamline Autos' direct-to-consumer (DTC) model for electric vehicles poses a significant strategic threat. By eliminating dealership markups, they can undercut traditional pricing, which may erode our market share among price-sensitive EV buyers. Furthermore, their direct engagement allows for real-time data collection on consumer preferences, enabling faster product iterations and more targeted marketing. To mitigate this impact, we should consider enhancing our own digital sales channels, improving transparency in pricing, and leveraging our existing dealership network for superior after-sales service and customer experience, which remains a key differentiator for traditional automakers.
